digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verification and recovery workflow
propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py exceed or are at the 800 LOC module-size CI cap, blocking any further edits without first decomposing concerns

completion.py mixes four distinct concerns (orchestration, child-closure gate, epic bug-screen floor, verdict reconciliation) and completion_recovery.py mixes three (criteria surface, failure taxonomy, recovery orchestration), each deserving separate modules with clear contractual boundaries

The refactor splits completion.py into completion.py (250 LOC verifier orchestration facade), new completion_child_gate.py (200 LOC deterministic closure gate), and new completion_reconcile.py (246 LOC verdict normalization), while absorbing the epic bug-screen DET layer into epic_bug_screen.py to unify the entire screen

The refactor splits completion_recovery.py into completion_recovery.py (423 LOC CompletionAgentStep orchestration), new completion_criteria.py (210 LOC criteria contract), and new completion_failures.py (234 LOC failure taxonomy), with stable re-exports preserving all existing public seams
All moves are behavior-preserving along existing call-graph seams; tests require import-path and monkeypatch-target updates only with zero assertion changes
